prompt: Our mum says my younger sister (can) watch one cartoon after dinner.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому модальный глагол can не меняется.

prompt: Did Kenji tell you he (can) fix your broken phone screen in an hour?
explanation_ru: Речь передаётся в прошедшем времени (Did ... tell), поэтому модальный глагол can сдвигается в could.

prompt: At our first judo class, the coach explained we (should) bow on the mat.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол should в косвенной речи не меняется даже после вводного глагола в прошедшем времени.

prompt: On Friday evening Dad told us we (must) finish our homework first.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол must в значении обязанности в прошлом переходит в косвенной речи в had to.

prompt: A voice at Milan station announced the Rome train (may) arrive twenty minutes late.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (announced) модальный глагол may сдвигается в might.

prompt: The German engineer points at the model. She explains that the new satellite (will) send weather photos every hour.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол explains стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому will остаётся без сдвига в would.

prompt: My laptop battery hit five per cent. Matteo warned me that if it (to die), our call (will / not) reconnect.
explanation_ru: Реальное условие (1-й тип) в прошедшей косвенной речи сдвигается: в придаточном с if используется Past Simple (died), а will not переходит в wouldn't.

prompt: Why did Priya claim the old camera under her desk (might) still work with fresh batteries?
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол might в косвенной речи не изменяется, даже когда вводный глагол стоит в прошедшем времени.

prompt: The drummer looked panicked before the show. The singer complained that he (could / not) play the last song without notes.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол could в косвенной речи сохраняет свою форму, поэтому в отрицании ставится couldn't.

prompt: Whenever a new helper joins the Viking ship project, the builder reminds him that he (must) keep the wood in water.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол reminds употреблён в настоящем времени для регулярного правила, поэтому must не сдвигается в had to.

prompt: School pickup was chaos on that narrow London street. Jack warned the driver that she (may) get a fine if she (to leave) her car on the yellow line.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после warned модальный глагол may переходит в might, а глагол в реальном условии (if-clause) сдвигается в Past Simple (left).

prompt: We looked exhausted after our flight to Lima. The head chef told us he (would) gladly swap our rice for salad if we (to want) a lighter dinner.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол would в косвенной речи не меняется, а глагол в придаточном с if сдвигается в прошедшее время (wanted).

prompt: Hannah visited our flat in Auckland to check how my wife was feeling. She smiled and mentioned that the baby (might) arrive a week early. She also added that if the baby (to come) early, we would simply drive straight to the clinic.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол might остаётся без изменений, а в условном придаточном после глагола в прошедшем времени (added) используется Past Simple (came).

prompt: We spread our blankets on the grass in an Oslo park while the sun grew hotter. Half an hour later, Ingrid insisted that we (should) start eating immediately. She pointed out that if we (to wait) any longer, the cheese sandwiches would get warm. Nobody argued, and we opened the basket right away.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол should в косвенной речи не меняется, а условие 1-го типа сдвигается в Past Simple (waited) в пару к would get.

prompt: Diego invited several friends to his new flat in Cordoba for a late dinner. Before midnight, he assured me that I (could) stay on his sofa overnight. He explained that if the night buses (to stop) running, a taxi across town would cost too much. Why didn't I think to pack a spare shirt?
explanation_ru: Глагол could при передаче речи в прошлом не меняется, а реальное условие в if-придаточном переходит из Present Simple в Past Simple (stopped).

prompt: During a coding course in Kyiv, Olena accidentally deleted a line from the live webpage. Thankfully, she had saved a backup copy five minutes earlier. Her mentor told her that if she (to forget) to save it, the whole site (would / crash) during the demo. He also reminded the group that they (have to) send him their final files before Friday's test.
explanation_ru: Условие 3-го типа о нереальном прошлом (had forgotten ... would have crashed) в косвенной речи не меняется, а have to после reminded сдвигается в had to.

prompt: Thick fog covered the Swiss mountain station all morning, delaying our supply delivery. Around eleven, Clara radioed the valley with better news about the sky. She reported that if the wind (to stay) calm, the helicopter would land before noon, and added that the crew (have to) wear bright jackets near the landing pad. Twenty minutes later, we heard the engine overhead.
explanation_ru: После глагола reported условная часть сдвигается в Past Simple (stayed), а конструкция have to для обязанности в прошлом переходит в had to.

prompt: The reading room in Bern went quiet when Samir closed his textbook. In a low voice, he explained that if his visa (to arrive) late, he would miss the final exam. His tutor whispered back that he (ought to) email the exam office before five o'clock. Samir nodded and opened his laptop straight away.
explanation_ru: Условие с if в прошедшей косвенной речи требует Past Simple (arrived), а модальный глагол ought to, как и should, остаётся без изменений.

prompt: Rehearsals at the drama studio in Lagos ran smoothly until someone brought out tins of bright paint. The teacher immediately reminded us that we (be allowed to) use simple homemade costumes for the play. However, she warned that if anyone (to spill) paint on the wooden stage, the school would cancel the show. She added that we (had better) put the tins back in the cupboard at once.
explanation_ru: После прошедших вводных глаголов are allowed to сдвигается в were allowed to, условие переходит в Past Simple (spilled/spilt), а оборот had better не меняется.

prompt: Last month Minji told us the team ___ practise in the main hall.
explanation_ru: В прошлом контексте после told глагол can переходит в could. Типичная ошибка — оставить can без сдвига или добавить лишнее to после could.

prompt: When my plans changed, Luca promised he ___ move my flight for free.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (promised) will сдвигается в would без частицы to. Ошибка — оставить will или написать would to.

prompt: The motorway out of Muscat was completely jammed. Yousef told us that if we ___ the coast road, we would arrive sooner.
explanation_ru: В придаточном условии с if в косвенной речи используется Past Simple (took), а не would или will. Ставить would внутри if-части — частая ошибка.

prompt: Before we got on the ski lift, the instructor advised us that beginners ___ go anywhere near the steep black run.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи should not сохраняется и не требует вспомогательного did или частицы to. Вариант did not have to искажает смысл (означает «не обязаны»).

prompt: Astrid studied last year's Arctic charts in northern Norway. She remarked that the sea ice ___ two weeks earlier if the spring winds had been warmer.
explanation_ru: Условие 3-го типа о прошлом (would have melted ... if ... had been) в косвенной речи не меняется. Ошибка — заменить его на would melt или had melted.

prompt: Yesterday the Toronto librarian told me I must return the map before five.
answer: Yesterday the Toronto librarian told me I had to return the map before five.
accepted_answers: Yesterday the Toronto librarian told me I had to return the map before five.
Yesterday the Toronto librarian told me that I had to return the map before five.
Yesterday, the Toronto librarian told me I had to return the map before five.
Yesterday, the Toronto librarian told me that I had to return the map before five.
explanation_ru: Для обязанности в завершённом прошлом (Yesterday ... told) must в косвенной речи нужно заменить на had to. Типичная ошибка — оставить must без сдвига.

prompt: Everyone stared at the clock in our Mexico City office. Our manager admitted we might have to work late.
answer: Everyone stared at the clock in our Mexico City office. Our manager admitted we might have to work late.
accepted_answers: Everyone stared at the clock in our Mexico City office. Our manager admitted we might have to work late.
Everyone stared at the clock in our Mexico City office. Our manager admitted that we might have to work late.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: модальный глагол might в косвенной речи не меняется даже после глагола в прошедшем времени (admitted).

prompt: On the Peruvian TV set, the director reminded the actor that if he would step back, they would restart filming.
answer: On the Peruvian TV set, the director reminded the actor that if he stepped back, they would restart filming.
accepted_answers: On the Peruvian TV set, the director reminded the actor that if he stepped back, they would restart filming.
On the Peruvian TV set, the director reminded the actor if he stepped back, they would restart filming.
explanation_ru: После if в условном придаточном нельзя ставить would — нужен Past Simple (stepped). Частая ошибка — переносить would в обе части условного предложения.

prompt: When we camped in Kruger Park last August, the ranger explained that visitors cannot light any open fires during that unusually dry week.
answer: When we camped in Kruger Park last August, the ranger explained that visitors could not light any open fires during that unusually dry week.
accepted_answers: When we camped in Kruger Park last August, the ranger explained that visitors could not light any open fires during that unusually dry week.
When we camped in Kruger Park last August, the ranger explained that visitors couldn't light any open fires during that unusually dry week.
When we camped in Kruger Park last August, the ranger explained visitors could not light any open fires during that unusually dry week.
When we camped in Kruger Park last August, the ranger explained visitors couldn't light any open fires during that unusually dry week.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о конкретной неделе в прошлом (last August), поэтому после explained глагол cannot должен сдвинуться в could not / couldn't.

prompt: At Rotterdam port, a worker said, "You must not walk near that crane."
options: The worker told us we did not have to walk near that crane.
The worker told us we must not walk near that crane.
The worker told us we should walk near that crane.
The worker told us we had to walk near that crane.
explanation_ru: Запрет must not в косвенной речи сохраняется. Ошибка — заменить его на did not have to («не обязательно»), что полностью меняет смысл.

prompt: Ji-yeon filmed a soup tutorial in Seoul yesterday. She told viewers, "You can use beans instead of fish, though you shouldn't skip the garlic if you want real flavour."
options: Ji-yeon said viewers could use beans instead of fish, though they shouldn't leave out the garlic if they wanted real flavour.
Ji-yeon said viewers can use beans instead of fish, though they didn't have to leave out the garlic if they want real flavour.
Ji-yeon said viewers could use beans instead of fish, though they didn't should leave out the garlic if they would want real flavour.
Ji-yeon said viewers might use beans instead of fish, though they shouldn't have left out the garlic if they had wanted real flavour.
explanation_ru: В первом варианте верно выполнены все переходы: can → could, shouldn't без изменений и want → wanted в условии. В остальных есть ошибки с временем, didn't should или искажением смысла.

prompt: Inside the game forum, the moderator told me, "You shouldn't post links if you don't know the rules." → The moderator told me …
answer: The moderator told me I shouldn't post links if I didn't know the rules.
accepted_answers: The moderator told me I shouldn't post links if I didn't know the rules.
The moderator told me that I shouldn't post links if I didn't know the rules.
The moderator told me I should not post links if I did not know the rules.
The moderator told me that I should not post links if I did not know the rules.
The moderator told me I shouldn't post links if I did not know the rules.
The moderator told me that I shouldn't post links if I did not know the rules.
The moderator told me I should not post links if I didn't know the rules.
The moderator told me that I should not post links if I didn't know the rules.
explanation_ru: Модальный глагол shouldn't остаётся без изменений, местоимение you переходит в I, а условие don't know сдвигается в Past Simple (didn't know).
